first_run.label: Nnọọ na MathTrail
first_run.lead: MathTrail na-enye nwata ajụjụ mgbakọ na mwepụ dị ka nke asọmpi maka klaasị 1 ruo 6, ebe a n'ime nkata, ma na-akọwa njehie ọ bụla. Onye toro eto na-edozi ya: nne ma ọ bụ nna, ma ọ bụ onye nkuzi nkeonwe.
first_run.pseudonym: A na-amata nwata ahụ naanị site n'aha nzuzo: etinyela ezigbo aha, ụbọchị ọmụmụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ya.
first_run.fill: Aha nzuzo na klaasị, site na 1 ruo 6. Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ, mmasị nwata ahụ, ihe amụbeghị n'ụlọ akwụkwọ, na asụsụ nkuzi.
first_run.data: N'otu faịlụ na Google Drive nke gị, nke ị nwere ike imepe, ibudata ma ọ bụ ihichapụ. MathTrail anaghị edebe ihe ọ bụla n'akụkụ ya.
first_run.start: Biko rịọ profaịlụ MathTrail n'ime nkata a, wee zaa ihe ọ jụrụ. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya ma emechaa, na “Profaịlụ na ọganihu”.

advice.off_by_one: Tupu a zaa, ka a see obere ihe osise: ogidi dị ka ntụpọ na oghere dị n'etiti ha, wee gụọ ha abụọ.
advice.missed_case: Ka a depụta nhọrọ n'usoro a kapịrị ọnụ, site na nke kacha nta, wee kaa nke ọ bụla akara ka ọ ghara inwe nke a hapụrụ.
advice.double_count: Ka e dee nhọrọ ọ bụla otu ugboro, n'usoro a kapịrị ọnụ, wee chọọ ndị kwughachiri tupu a gụọ ha.
advice.ignored_not: Ka a gụọ ajụjụ ahụ n'olu dara ụda, wee gbaa okwu “ọ bụghị” gburugburu tupu a dozie ya.
advice.answered_other_question: Tupu a zaa, ka a kọwaa n'okwu nke onwe ihe ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ, wee jiri ya nyochaa azịza ahụ.
advice.stopped_early: Mgbe nzọụkwụ ọ bụla gasịrị, ka a jụọ ma ọ bụ ihe ajụjụ chọrọ, ka ọ bụ naanị nzọụkwụ na-eru ya.
advice.wrong_operation: Ka e jiri obere ihe ma ọ bụ ihe osise gosipụta akụkọ ahụ, ka a hụ ma a na-agbakwụnye, na-ewepụ ma ọ bụ na-ekesa.
advice.reversed_relation: Ka a see ntụnyere ahụ n'ahịrị site na nke kacha nta ruo nke kacha ukwuu tupu a gụọ azịza.
advice.best_case_not_worst: Ka a jụọ ụzọ kacha njọ ihe nwere ike isi mee, wee hụ na azịza ahụ ka guzosiri ike ọbụna mgbe ahụ.
advice.trusted_statement: Maka okwu ọ bụla, ka a nwaa ha abụọ: ihe na-esote ma ọ bụrụ eziokwu, na ihe na-esote ma ọ bụrụ ụgha.
advice.time_unit_mixup: Ka a see ihu elekere wee gụọ n'ihu na nkeji, na-echeta na otu awa nwere nkeji 60, ọ bụghị 100.
advice.number_from_text: Tupu e dee ọnụọgụgụ, ka a kwuo mgbakọ o si na ya pụta: ọnụọgụgụ e detuuru site n'ajụjụ anaghị abụkarị azịza.
advice.wrong_parity: Ka a buru ụzọ nyochaa ikewa n'abụọ na obere ọnụọgụgụ, dị ka 1 + 3 na 3 + 5, wee kwuo iwu ahụ n'olu dara ụda.
advice.ignored_condition: Ka a gụghachi ajụjụ ahụ wee kaa ihe ọ bụla ọ chọrọ akara, dị ka “dị iche iche” ma ọ bụ “naanị otu ugboro”, wee jiri nke ọ bụla nyochaa azịza ahụ.
advice.percent_wrong_base: Ka a buru ụzọ jụọ: pasentị nke gịnị? Ka e dee ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru oke ahụ tupu e were pasentị ahụ.
advice.part_whole_swap: Ka a see ihe zuru oke dị ka ogwe, kpuchie akụkụ ahụ agba, wee lelee nke n'ime ha abụọ ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ.
advice.ratio_total_confusion: Ka a see mmekọrịta ahụ dị ka igbe ndị ha nhata, gụọ igbe niile maka mkpokọta, wee chọpụta ihe otu igbe na-ebu.
advice.remainder_vs_quotient: Ka e kee ezigbo ihe n'ìgwè, wee kwuo n'olu dara ụda ọnụọgụgụ nke bụ ìgwè ndị ahụ na nke bụ ihe fọdụrụ.
advice.area_perimeter_swap: Ka e jiri mkpịsị aka sochie nsọtụ ya maka gburugburu, ma tee agba n'ime ya maka mpaghara, wee gụghachi nke a jụrụ.
advice.first_move_assumed: Ka a gbaa egwuregwu ahụ ugboro ole na ole mgbe ihe ole na ole fọdụrụ, wee hụ onye meriri nke ọ bụla tupu e kpebie.
